reviewed_cases.finding: 4F7877 overlaps the eighth expected entry byte; when reached the handler restores its own bytes and 4F8361. Ares returns to 4F8361 and skips vanilla interior. Neither DLL presence nor root-E9 inference proves a Phobos-only adapter.
48DC90 root and 6FBFA0+3 require distinct cdecl/thiscall receiver, stack, returned-value and extension-filtering validation. Call the original function entry, not the middle hook.
6A9316 changes registers/continuation; 478E4A E9 cannot be treated as a compatible data operand instruction.
55D360 writer and 55DED5 context intersect; require explicit pause/step ownership and lifecycle, not generic chaining.
7E2908 replaces a four-byte target with a fastcall receiver-based boolean implementation; vanilla expected target is 41CB50. A future wrapper needs verified ABI and actual-pointer ownership/restore.
